environment.description: CI/CD pipeline cache plugin running on ECS Fargate tasks with IAM role 'ci-cache-plugin-role'. The role has s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject, and s3:DeleteObject permissions on the entire cache bucket (arn:aws:s3:::ci-artifact-cache-prod/*). No permission boundary attached. Multiple pipeline projects share the same cache bucket with only logical prefix separation. The task role trust policy allows any ECS task in the account to assume it.
